title: Stable pairings
notes: K-1 can begin with one two-pair candidate in P1, pointing to both fixed strips for each possible blocking pair; an adult reads, but the child chooses which candidate to test. P1-2 are a complete introductory encounter. Return to P3-4 only when the child can check both wishes against the same current pairing; constructing whole profiles in P5-6 is further readiness-dependent work. If the checks are still one-sided, continue the concrete two-pair demonstration and defer the later tasks. Grades 2-3 can return to the larger profile or exact-two construction (P4-5). Grades 4-5 can choose the changed-rule counterexample (P3), the asking-rule proofs (P4-5), or the last-choice optimum (P6) as separate visits. Keep all lists fixed within a trial.
